description: BTPS 1.2 BoundView reference pictures. Each `document` carries a BoundView that passes every check; drawn at `scale` by the rendering rules, the PNG renderBoundView gives has the SHA-256 `sha256`. A receiver that draws BoundViews some other way must draw these the same, pixel for pixel; this set checks the reference engine gives these exact bytes.
